outcome: Fetal malformations (micromelia, talipes equinovarus, spinal abnormalities)
Improved parental understanding of fetal malformations
cohort: A single case involving a 12-year-old primigravida mother whose fetus was diagnosed with diastrophic dysplasia prenatally.
finding: 2D and 3D ultrasonography allowed for the prenatal diagnosis of diastrophic dysplasia, with 3D ultrasound further enhancing parental understanding of the fetal malformations.
